---
title: "Site Selection"
author: "Elizabeth Buhr"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: word_document
---

This document identifies sites within selected fires (fires from 2010-2024, >=10% extent treated area, >1500 min elevation, in Colorado) for multi-scale landscape analysis (plots) and fine-scale progression analysis (transects) following methods from Jones et al 2025. Sites will be used to analyze the effect of treatment extent and distance from treatment edge, among other treatment characteristics and covariates.

Plot Selection:

  1. Generate points with random x-y coordinates in each fire, minimum 500m from the fire perimeter and 1000m away from each other. 
  2. Generate buffered circles surrounding points with varying radii (100, 250, and 500m). Adjusted distances from Jones 2025 due to fewer sampling opportunities in my fires.

Transect Selection:

  1.  Create radial lines from point of ignition to fire perimeter. Generate points 50m apart along these lines.
  2. Identify sequences of 10 points which have 5 points in a treatment and 5 outside.
  3. Thin treatment transects to 500m apart on all sides.
  4. Select control transects (sequence of 10 points outside of a treatment by at least 500m).
  

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

# Set-Up
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(exactextractr)
library(lwgeom) #spherical functions for transects
library(RcppRoll) #rolling operations for transects

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
```

```{r}
target_crs <- "EPSG:26913"
set.seed(42)
```

Read in Selected Fires
```{r}
fires <- st_read("data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg", layer = "fires") %>%
  mutate(
    Area_SqM = as.numeric(st_area(.))   # Get area in square meters for radial lines
  ) %>%
  st_transform(target_crs)
```

Read in TCC
```{r}
#Read in 1999 TCC Cover to only select sites with >10% tree cover prior to any treatment or fire

tcc <- rast("D:/Spatial_Data/NLCD/nlcd_tcc_CONUS_1999_v2023-5_wgs84/nlcd_tcc_conus_wgs84_v2023-5_19990101_19991231.tif")
```

Read in Treatments
```{r}
#Collapse treatment dataset
treatments <- st_read("data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg", layer = "treatments") %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(target_crs)

treatments <- treatments %>%
  mutate(Trt_Type = case_when(
    MGT_TYPE == "Wildfire" ~ "Wildfire",
    ACTIVITY %in% c("Removal", "Pile Burn") ~ "Removal",
    ACTIVITY %in% "Broadcast Burn" ~ "Broadcast Burn"
  ))

flat <- st_union(treatments)
```

# Plot Selection

Candidate plot centers are generated within each fire interior (excluding a 550 m edge buffer). Candidates are retained if mean TCC is at least 10% at all buffer scales, then stratified into bins of proportion treated area at the 250 m scale. Plots are selected per fire up to a fixed quota per bin, subject to a 1000 m minimum spacing between plot centers.

```{r}
# Shrink the fires by 550m to satisfy the edge requirement
# st_buffer with a negative value creates an inner buffer
fire_interiors <- st_buffer(fires, dist = -550)

# ---- Parameters ----
radii        <- c(100, 250, 500)
strat_radius <- 100                      # scale used to define gradient bins
bin_breaks   <- c(-Inf, 0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.99, Inf)
bin_labels   <- c("0", "0-10%", "10-25%", "25-50%", "50-75%", "75-99%", "100%")
quota        <- setNames(rep(50, length(bin_labels)), bin_labels)  # max plots per bin, per fire
quota["0"]   <- 50
n_bg         <- 500                      # candidates across the whole fire interior
n_edge       <- 1500                     # candidates near treatment boundaries
edge_width   <- 300                      # m on either side of a treatment boundary
min_dist     <- 1000
ctrl_dist    <- 2000                     # m; controls drawn within this distance of a treatment

# ---- Helpers ----
make_buffers <- function(pts, radii) {
  lapply(radii, function(r) st_buffer(pts, r) %>% mutate(buffer_radius = r)) %>%
    bind_rows()
}

add_prop_treated <- function(bufs, trt) {
  bufs$buf_area <- as.numeric(st_area(bufs))
  bufs$trt_area <- 0
  if (length(trt) > 0 && !all(st_is_empty(trt))) {
    inter <- st_intersection(bufs[, c("point_id", "buffer_radius")], trt)
    key_b <- paste(bufs$point_id, bufs$buffer_radius)
    key_i <- paste(inter$point_id, inter$buffer_radius)
    bufs$trt_area[match(key_i, key_b)] <- as.numeric(st_area(inter))
  }
  bufs$prop_treated <- round(pmin(bufs$trt_area / bufs$buf_area, 1), 3)
  bufs
}

# ---- Per-fire loop ----
set.seed(42)
final_points_list  <- vector("list", nrow(fire_interiors))
final_buffers_list <- vector("list", nrow(fire_interiors))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(fire_interiors))) {

  fire       <- fire_interiors[i, ]
  incid_name <- fire$Incid_Name

  if (st_is_empty(fire)) {
    message("Fire ", i, " (", incid_name, "): skipped, interior empty after 550 m buffer")
    next
  }
  fire_geom <- st_geometry(fire)

  # Treatments near this fire (padding keeps the clip edge far from the interior)
  box       <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(st_buffer(fire_geom, 1000)))
  trt_local <- st_intersection(flat, box)
  has_trt   <- length(trt_local) > 0 && !all(st_is_empty(trt_local))

  # --- Candidate pool: background (near treatments) + points near treatment edges ---
  if (has_trt) {
    ctrl_zone <- st_buffer(st_union(trt_local), ctrl_dist) %>%
      st_intersection(fire_geom)
    bg_zone <- if (!all(st_is_empty(ctrl_zone))) ctrl_zone else fire_geom
  } else {
    bg_zone <- fire_geom   # no treatments in this fire; fall back to whole interior
  }
  pts <- st_sample(bg_zone, n_bg)

  if (has_trt) {
    edge_zone <- st_buffer(st_boundary(trt_local), edge_width) %>%
      st_intersection(fire_geom)
    if (!all(st_is_empty(edge_zone))) pts <- c(pts, st_sample(edge_zone, n_edge))
  }
  if (length(pts) == 0) {
    message("Fire ", i, " (", incid_name, "): skipped, no sample points")
    next
  }

  pool <- st_sf(geometry = pts) %>%
    mutate(
      Incid_Name = incid_name,
      Event_ID   = fire$Event_ID,
      Fire_Year  = fire$Fire_Year,
      point_id   = paste0(substr(incid_name, 1, 4), "_", row_number())
    )

  # --- Proportion treated + TCC for the whole pool, once ---
  bufs <- make_buffers(pool, radii) %>% add_prop_treated(trt_local)
  bufs$mean_tcc <- exact_extract(tcc, st_transform(bufs, crs(tcc)), "mean", progress = FALSE)

  tcc_ok <- bufs %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(point_id) %>%
    summarise(tcc_ok = !anyNA(mean_tcc) && all(mean_tcc >= 10), .groups = "drop")

  prop_wide <- bufs %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(point_id, buffer_radius, prop_treated) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = buffer_radius, values_from = prop_treated,
                names_prefix = "prop_trt_")

  cands <- pool %>%
    left_join(tcc_ok, by = "point_id") %>%
    left_join(prop_wide, by = "point_id") %>%
    filter(tcc_ok) %>%
    mutate(bin = cut(.data[[paste0("prop_trt_", strat_radius)]],
                     breaks = bin_breaks, labels = bin_labels))

  if (nrow(cands) == 0) {
    message("Fire ", i, " (", incid_name, "): skipped, no candidates met TCC >= 10")
    next
  }

  # --- Quota-based selection: scarce (non-zero) bins first, zeros last ---
  cands    <- cands %>% arrange(bin == "0", runif(n()))
  geom     <- st_geometry(cands)
  kept_idx <- integer(0)
  bin_n    <- setNames(rep(0, length(bin_labels)), bin_labels)

  for (k in seq_len(nrow(cands))) {
    b <- as.character(cands$bin[k])
    if (bin_n[b] >= quota[b]) next
    if (length(kept_idx) > 0 &&
        any(as.numeric(st_distance(geom[k], geom[kept_idx])) < min_dist)) next
    kept_idx <- c(kept_idx, k)
    bin_n[b] <- bin_n[b] + 1
  }

  kept <- cands[kept_idx, ] %>% select(-tcc_ok)

  final_points_list[[i]]  <- kept
  final_buffers_list[[i]] <- bufs %>% filter(point_id %in% kept$point_id)

  message("Fire ", i, " (", incid_name, "): ", nrow(kept), " plots selected")
}

# ---- Combine ----
final_points <- bind_rows(final_points_list)
all_buffers  <- bind_rows(final_buffers_list) %>% mutate(Plot_ID = paste0(substr(Incid_Name, 1, 4), "_", row_number(), "_", buffer_radius))
```

## Summary statistics

```{r}
all_buffers %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  ggplot(aes(prop_treated)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  facet_wrap(~buffer_radius)

# plots per fire x bin at the stratification scale
final_points %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(Incid_Name, bin) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = bin, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

final_points %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(Incid_Name)
```
 
## Save object

```{r}
all_buffers <- all_buffers %>%
  rename(Radius = buffer_radius) %>%
  select(Event_ID, Incid_Name, Fire_Year, Radius, Plot_ID)

st_write(
  obj = all_buffers,
  dsn = "data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg",
  layer = "all_plots_selected",
  driver = "GPKG",
  delete_layer= TRUE
)
```

Several fires did not meet the requirements for plot selection. Here we update and save our fire dataset to exclude these fires.

```{r}
fires <- fires %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Event_ID %in% unique(final_points$Event_ID))

st_write(
  obj = fires,
  dsn = "data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg",
  layer = "fires",
  driver = "GPKG",
  delete_layer= TRUE
)
```

Also update the treatment dataset so it only includes treatments for these fires.

```{r}
treatments <- treatments %>%
  st_filter(fires, .predicate = st_intersects)

st_write(
  obj = treatments,
  dsn = "data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg",
  layer = "treatments",
  driver = "GPKG",
  delete_layer= TRUE
)
```

# Transect Selection

This section selects transects entering and exiting treatment boundaries as well as control transects.

## Pre-Processing: Fire Origins

Prepare data by finding fire origins and creating a csv with 360 rows and an empty column for each fire. In ArcGIS, create radial lines from the fire origin. Generate points every 50m along each radial line. Create columns with a line ID and distance along line.

InForm (NIFC) was downloaded here: https://data-nifc.opendata.arcgis.com/datasets/nifc::inform-fire-occurrence-data-records/about 

Two fires (Junkins and Lake Christine) have ignition points outside of the fire perimeters. The Junkins point of origin was thus gathered from this report: https://wildfiretoday.com/tag/junkins-fire/. The Lake Christine point of origin was approximated as the southern most point (while the southern most point may be slightly west of the actual origin, due to a change in wind direction it should be more accurate for approximating fire spread).

```{r occurrence}
occurrence <- st_read("D:/Spatial_Data/InFORM_FireOccurrence_Public_1766480872051252493.gpkg") %>%
  st_transform(target_crs) %>%
  mutate(FireDiscoveryDateTime = as.POSIXct(FireDiscoveryDateTime, tz = "UTC")) %>%
  filter(year(FireDiscoveryDateTime) >= 2010,
         year(FireDiscoveryDateTime) <= 2024) %>%
  mutate(occurrence_year = year(FireDiscoveryDateTime)) %>%
  mutate(IncidentName = toupper(IncidentName))%>%
  dplyr::select(occurrence_year, IncidentName)

##Adjust points which are outside of perimeter##
#Add in Junkins point of origin by selecting western most point
junkcoords <- fires %>%
  filter(Incid_Name == "JUNKINS") %>%
  st_coordinates()
junkx <- min(junkcoords[ ,1]) #Minimum X coordinate = western most, which we can see is the origin from the report
junkorig <- junkcoords[junkcoords[, 1] == junkx, ]
junkorig <- st_sfc(
  st_point(c(junkorig[1], junkorig[2])),
  crs = st_crs(fires)
)
junkorigfin <- st_sf(
  occurrence_year = 2016,
  IncidentName   = "JUNKINS",
  SHAPE           = junkorig
)
#Add Lake Christine by selecting southern most point
lchristcoords <- fires %>%
  filter(Incid_Name == "LAKE CHRISTINE") %>%
  st_coordinates()
lchristy <- min(lchristcoords[ ,2]) #Minimum Y coordinate = southernmost
lchristorig <- lchristcoords[lchristcoords[, 2] == lchristy, ]
lchristorig <- st_sfc( #make spatial object from list
  st_point(c(lchristorig[1], lchristorig[2])),
  crs = st_crs(fires)
)
lchristorigfin <- st_sf(
  occurrence_year = 2018,
  IncidentName   = "LAKE CHRISTINE",
  SHAPE           = lchristorig
)
####
#Add our new origin points to our occurrence dataset
occurrence <- rbind(occurrence, junkorigfin, lchristorigfin)

occurrence_in_fires <- st_join(
  occurrence,
  fires,
  join = st_intersects,
  left = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(occurrence_year == Fire_Year,
         IncidentName == Incid_Name) %>%
  dplyr::select(c("Event_ID", "Incid_Name", "Ig_Date", "Fire_Year", "Area_SqM"))

# Save for visually confirming transect orientation with Day of Burning
st_write(occurrence_in_fires, here("data", "processed", "ignition_points.shp"), append=FALSE)

# Prep and Convert to CSV for ArcGIS Methods
# Extract the Projected Coordinates (X and Y)
# This creates new columns for X and Y based on your SHAPE field
coords <- st_coordinates(occurrence_in_fires)
occurrence_in_fires$X_Coord <- coords[,1]
occurrence_in_fires$Y_Coord <- coords[,2]

# Drop the spatial geometry to work with it as a table
occurrence_in_fires_df <- st_drop_geometry(occurrence_in_fires)

# Calculate a distance for each fire so that the radial lines cover the fire
occurrence_in_fires_df <- occurrence_in_fires_df %>%
  mutate(LineDist = sqrt(Area_SqM) * 3)

# Create a data frame of angles
angles <- data.frame(Bearing = 1:360)

# The "Cross Join": This multiplies your fires by the 360 angles
# Every fire will now have 360 rows, one for each degree.
radial_table <- occurrence_in_fires_df %>%
  crossing(angles)

# Save as a CSV to bring back into ArcGIS Pro
write.csv(radial_table, "data/processed/Radial_Lines_Input.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

In ArcGIS I created radial lines from the ignition points to the fire perimeter and added points along the lines. Instructions are in the document folder titled "Generating Radial Lines". *The output file from the ArcGIS process is necessary to continue.*

## Identify Candidate Transects

We need to find which transects (set of 10 sequential points) intersect treatments with 5 points in/out, and which transects are controls.

First, filter points so that each point has a minimum of 10% forest cover prior to any of our fires using 1999 NLCD TCC. 

```{r}
#load points
points <- st_read("data/processed/AllPoints/AllPoints1026.shp") %>%
  st_transform(crs(tcc))

tcc <- as.numeric(tcc)

points$tcc <- terra::extract(tcc, vect(points))[, 2]

# Remove points with <10% 1999 TCC and transform back to NAD83
points <- points %>%
  filter(tcc >= 10) %>%
  st_transform(target_crs)
```

Label each point as treated or untreated. 

```{r}
burn_treated <- treatments %>%
  filter(Trt_Type %in% c("Broadcast Burn", "Wildfire"))
flat <- st_union(burn_treated)

#label treated points
spiltmilk1 <- st_intersects(points, flat, sparse = FALSE)
points$is_treated <- rowSums(spiltmilk1) > 0
```

Identify entering, exiting, and control transect origins.

```{r}
#identify the treatment progression transects
valid_origins <- points %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Incid_Name, Bearing) %>% 
  arrange(ORIG_LEN, .by_group = TRUE) %>% #arrange sequentially, by length from origin within each fire along each line
  mutate(
    # Count how many of the NEXT 5 points are treated
    sum_next_5 = roll_sum(as.numeric(is_treated), n = 5, align = "left", fill = NA),
    # Get the sum of the 5 points AFTER those (points 6-10)
    sum_after_5 = lead(sum_next_5, 5),
    # Identify transects where all 10 points are not treated
    sum_next_10 = roll_sum(as.numeric(is_treated), n = 10, align = "left", fill = NA)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    (sum_next_5 == 5 & sum_after_5 == 0) | # 5 IN then 5 OUT
    (sum_next_5 == 0 & sum_after_5 == 5) |  # 5 OUT then 5 IN
    (sum_next_10 == 0) #Control
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    sum_next_5 == 5 & sum_after_5 == 0 ~ "exiting",
    sum_next_5 == 0 & sum_after_5 == 5 ~ "entering",
    sum_next_10 == 0 ~ "control"
  )) %>%
  ungroup()
```

Filter points to only those with valid origins.

```{r}
# Order points and index within each radial
pts <- points %>%
  arrange(Event_ID, ORIG_FID, ORIG_SEQ) %>%
  group_by(Event_ID, ORIG_FID) %>%
  mutate(row = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Get the origin row index for each valid origin
origins <- pts %>%
  inner_join(valid_origins,
            dplyr::select(Event_ID, ORIG_FID, ORIG_SEQ, type),
            by = c("Event_ID", "ORIG_FID", "ORIG_SEQ")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Event_ID, ORIG_FID, origin_row = row, type) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# Keep origin + next 9 points (10 total)
transect_pts <- pts %>%
  inner_join(
    origins %>% mutate(origin_end = origin_row + 9),
    by = join_by(Event_ID, ORIG_FID, between(row, origin_row, origin_end))
  ) %>%                                              
  group_by(Event_ID, ORIG_FID, origin_row, type) %>%
  filter(
    n() == 10,
    (max(ORIG_SEQ) - min(ORIG_SEQ)) == 9,
    n_distinct(ORIG_SEQ) == 10
  ) %>%
  mutate(Point_ID = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Filter for Spacing

Make transects into line objects and enforce spacing rules. Prioritize selecting treatment transects (entering/exiting) before controls during spacing.

```{r}
transect_pts <- transect_pts %>%
  group_by(Event_ID, Incid_Name, ORIG_FID, origin_row, type) %>%
  mutate(Transect_ID = cur_group_id()) %>%
  ungroup()

transect_lines <- transect_pts %>% #this takes awhile
  arrange(Event_ID, Incid_Name, ORIG_FID, Transect_ID, ORIG_SEQ) %>%
  group_by(Transect_ID, Event_ID, Incid_Name, ORIG_FID) %>%
  summarize(geometry = st_cast(st_combine(geometry), "LINESTRING"),
            type = first(type),
            .groups = "drop") 

#Treatment transects should be prioritized in selection, which can be done by ordering them first. Use type column to create treated column then arrange.

transect_lines <- transect_lines %>% 
  mutate(treatment = ifelse(type == "control", FALSE, TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(treatment))

#Remove transect lines within 50m of fire perimeter to avoid effects of fire suppression
fire_interiors2 <- st_buffer(fires, dist = -50)
transect_lines <- transect_lines %>%
  st_filter(fire_interiors2, .predicate = st_within)

# Enforce 500m spacing between transect lines
keep_indices <- c()
remaining_indices <- 1:nrow(transect_lines)

while (length(remaining_indices) > 0) {
  # Pick the first (highest priority) line remaining
  current_idx <- remaining_indices[1]
  keep_indices <- c(keep_indices, current_idx)
  
  # Find all lines within 500m of this line
  too_close <- st_is_within_distance(transect_lines[current_idx, ], 
                                    transect_lines[remaining_indices, ], 
                                    dist = 500)[[1]]
  
  # Remove the current line and all "too close" lines from the pool
  remaining_indices <- remaining_indices[-too_close]
}

# Filter the original dataset
thinned_transects <- transect_lines[keep_indices, ]
```

Filter control transects to equal the number of treatment transects.

```{r}
#First buffer treatments by 500m and remove the control transects that are too close
treatments_buffered <- st_buffer(flat, dist = 500)

  #Separate the treatment
treated_yes <- thinned_transects %>% 
  filter(treatment == TRUE)

  #Filter the FALSE rows (only keep if NOT within treatments_buffered)
treated_no_filtered <- thinned_transects %>% 
  filter(treatment == FALSE) %>%
  # st_filter keeps what intersects; we use st_disjoint to avoid this
  st_filter(treatments_buffered, .predicate = st_disjoint)

  #Combine them back into one object
thinned_transects <- bind_rows(treated_yes, treated_no_filtered)

#Randomly select control transects to equal the number of treatment transects

balanced_transects <- thinned_transects %>%
  # 1. Group by the fire ID and the treatment status
  group_by(Event_ID) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    # Count how many treatment transects exist in this specific fire
    n_treated <- round(sum(.x$treatment == TRUE)/2)
    
    # Separate the treated and control groups for this fire
    treated_rows <- .x %>% filter(treatment == TRUE)
    control_rows <- .x %>% filter(treatment == FALSE)
    
    # 2. Randomly sample from controls to match n_treated
    # Use pmin to avoid errors if a fire has fewer controls than treated lines
    sampled_controls <- control_rows %>%
      slice_sample(n = pmin(nrow(control_rows), n_treated))
    
    # 3. Combine them back for this fire
    bind_rows(treated_rows, sampled_controls)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

SumStatsTransects <- balanced_transects %>%
  arrange(Incid_Name) %>%
  group_by(Incid_Name, type) %>%
  summarize(n = n()) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()
SumStatsTransects
```

Add points back to transects now that they are thinned.

```{r}
transects_final <- transect_pts %>%
  semi_join(balanced_transects %>% st_drop_geometry(), 
            by = c("Event_ID", "ORIG_FID", "Transect_ID")) %>%
  mutate(Transect_ID = paste0(substr(Incid_Name, 1, 4), "_", Transect_ID)) %>%
  rename(Type = type,
         Point_Num = Point_ID) %>%
  dplyr::select(Event_ID, Incid_Name, Fire_Year, Transect_ID, Point_Num, Type)
```

## Save object in GPKG

```{r}
st_write(
  obj = transects_final,
  dsn = "data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg",
  layer = "transects_selected",
  driver = "GPKG",
  delete_layer= TRUE
)
```
